text:
alyssa-sec: FYI found a partner upload that contains an env tar.gz with VAULT_ADDR and two base64 blocks that look like KMS ciphertext. path: s3://partner-ingest-prod/2026-04-02/ingest.tar.gz. tagging @devon-ops @tanner-eng for containment.

devon-ops: do not delete. snapshot object to forensics bucket and remove partner read role from bucket ACLs. I'll run the ACL change now.

tanner-eng: if the ciphertext is wrapped with our key, assume decryption possible. can you paste the ciphertext header string?
alyssa-sec: header shows: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap-key. looks like our key id.

tanner-eng: bad. immediate: 1) revoke any long-lived SA keys that have decrypt activity 2) add a temporary deny binding for partner accounts on that key 3) rotate transit keys in Vault and rewrap affected ciphertexts. I'll prepare commands.
devon-ops: ACL updated, snapshot saved to gs://forensics/ingest/1829995555/ingest.tar.gz. disabled partner iam binding on bucket.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-075 created by alyssa-sec: "Partner upload contains potential secret leak" assigned to @alyssa-sec, severity P1.
tanner-eng: commands to enumerate principals: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" --freshness=30d --format=json | jq -r '.[].protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail' | sort -u` then disable suspicious SA keys. For Vault: `vault write -f transit/keys/partner-wrap-key/rotate` then rewrap via internal job with rate limits.
alyssa-sec: found one plaintext partner API token in the tarball (not ours). redacted, moved to forensics. also opened PR on ingest pipeline to block uploads with VAULT_ADDR or VAULT_TOKEN.
marta-pm: I'll notify partner security/legal and prepare internal customer-notify draft. keep me updated on scope.
tanner-eng: performed IAM deny and disabled two suspect SA keys. ran canary rewrap for prefix `partner/2026/04/` on 2k objects; no downstream failures after 20m. enabling KMS audit export to locked bucket now.
alyssa-sec: enabling alert for any future decrypt calls from non-platform principals. schedule postmortem and policy PR to tighten roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to platform-kms-proxy + key-owners.
marta-pm: noted, scheduling postmortem tomorrow and assigning action owners. leaving thread open until follow-ups complete.
